::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Is there a way I can use Tahoma font from Microsoft in latex?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/165310/is-there-a-way-i-can-use-tahoma-font-from-microsoft-in-latex), asked by [user1343318](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/47611/user1343318) on TeX Stack Exchange (2014-03-13; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> Googling the question yields many posts but no definite answer. Is there a way to use Tahoma font in latex?
:::

Assuming you have the `Tahoma.ttf` file installed in a place your system can find it (on my mac it's in `/Macintosh HD/Library/Fonts`), then using it is as simple as

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{Tahoma}

\begin{document}
Hello, world!
\end{document}
```

You have to take care to compile this with XeLaTeX (`xelatex`) or LuaLaTeX (`lualatex`) instead of regular LaTeX.
